name: Sakana
source:
A girl hiding in the shadows, having been imprisoned by her parents to be used as a test subject. Upon being told that her life is coming to an end, her only wish is to know more about the outside world. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
